articles.title: Citizens for Justice and Peace members challenge judicial custody in Delhi High Court
articles.summary: Citizens for Justice and Peace members Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka approached the Delhi High Court on Tuesday to challenge their judicial custody. The legal challenge comes a day before a special executive magistrate decides whether to extend their detention. Their cases have reportedly been handed over to the Crime Branch for further investigation.

articles.title: Delhi Police transfers second case against two political leaders to Crime Branch
articles.summary: Delhi Police transferred a second first information report against Cockroach Janta Party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka to the Crime Branch on Tuesday. The leaders were detained on October 13 after allegedly trespassing into the denotified Jantar Mantar area in Delhi. They have approached the Delhi High Court seeking an urgent hearing against their ongoing judicial custody extension.

articles.title: India to build access-controlled ring roads, bypasses to curb urban congestion
articles.summary: Subscribe to enjoy similar stories. articles.title: HP Guv Kavinder releases books on Dogri theatre

articles.title: Tamil Nadu must improve power demand forecast, cut costs with timely buys
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu’s decision to buy emergency electricity at rates reaching ₹37 a unit raises questions about its power procurement strategy. articles.title: On a High-way: India revamps highway EPC rules with rating-based deposits, crash penalties
articles.summary: The Centre has revised performance security measures for national highway contractors based on their ratings. Contractors rated above 80% will deposit 3% of project value, while lower-rated contractors will deposit 4% or 5%. This initiative aims to incentivize quality in highway construction and improve contractors' cash flow. Additionally, higher standards for land acquisition and compensation mechanisms have been established.

articles.title: Romania Parliament Approves New Pro-European Government Led By Luca Niculescu

articles.title: Apple India's revenue more than doubles in 3 years, crosses ₹1 lakh crore
articles.summary: Apple India Pvt Ltd's revenue from operations crossed ₹1 lakh crore for the first time in FY26, rising 31% year on year to ₹1,03,853 crore. Revenue has more than doubled from ₹49,188 crore in FY23, according to filings with the Registrar of Companies (RoC) and reports. Net profit rose 66% to ₹5,311 crore in FY26 from ₹3,196 crore in FY25.

articles.summary_hi: पंजाब पुलिस के एक अधिकारी ने मंगलवार को पंजाब के मनसा जिले में कथित तौर पर अपनी पत्नी और दो बेटों को गोली मारने से पहले खुद को गोली मार ली। शुरुआती जानकारी के मुताबिक घटना घरेलू विवाद से जुड़ी हुई लग रही है. पुलिस ने सीएनएन-न्यूज18 को बताया कि मनसा के डिप्टी कमिश्नर को सौंपे गए गनमैन गुरविंदर सिंह ने मंगलवार सुबह गोली चलाकर कथित तौर पर खुद को मार डाला.

articles.summary_hinglish: panjaba pulisa ke eka adhikari ne mangalavara ko panjaba ke manasa jile men kathita taura para apani patni aura do beton ko goli marane se pahale khuda ko goli mara li। shuruaati janakari ke mutabika ghatana gharelu vivada se judaी huee laga rahi hai. pulisa ne sienaena-nyuja18 ko bataya ki manasa ke dipti kamishnara ko saunpe gae ganamaina guravindara sinha ne mangalavara subaha goli chalakara kathita taura para khuda ko mara dal.
